memory_and_audit_cases.assertion: long-term memory includes source_message_id,confidence,created_at,updated_at and a stable version
memory extraction failure records safe trace state but does not block primary answer
correct preserves original source and increments version; deactivate increments version; delete removes online retrieval eligibility
review audit records reviewer subject,request_id,timestamp,old/new status and content summary for success and conflict, never tokens
needs_review candidate is withheld from ordinary user until approve or edit-and-publish

frontend_state_cases.assertion: new and restored session states are distinguishable and message history is ordered
SSE consumes all nine event types; reconnect de-duplicates (run_id,sequence)
stop invokes server cancellation, not only AbortController; cancelled terminal UI cannot append late delta
retry reuses original user message and renders new run state
loading,empty,error,disabled,tool,citation,and review-withheld states are visible and keyboard operable

rag_gate_cases.assertion: fixed dataset has 25-30 stable cases: >=12 single-source,>=4 multi-source,>=4 unanswerable,>=3 confusing,>=2 injection
each case has answerability, expected document_id/chunk_id, forbidden sources, tags and change rationale
relative to approved baseline: retrieval_hit_rate@5,mrr@10,ndcg@10,citation_support_precision drop <=0.03; integrity and injection defense never drop
